card.name: Capitalized words in all-caps warning text
card.fires_on: Words or word starts written in ALL CAPS inside an all-caps warning sentence, often right after a period or a comma. Typical examples are THE, IN, AN, WOM, MAN and BR.

modes.label: Sentence-opening THE
modes.description: The word THE starts a new all-caps sentence in a label warning.
modes.example: VED AND BE UNDER A PHYSICIAN’S CARE THROUGHOUT THERAPY.<< THE>> USE OF METHOTREXATE HIGH

modes.label: IN GENERAL phrase
modes.description: The word IN begins the phrase IN GENERAL inside an all-caps beta-blocker warning.
modes.example: PATIENTS WITH BRONCHOSPASTIC PULMONARY DISEASE SHOULD,<< IN>> GENERAL, NOT RECEIVE BETA-BLOCK

modes.label: Start of split caps word
modes.description: The first piece of a long all-caps word, such as WOMAN, ANIMAL or MANIFESTED.
modes.example: OR ELECTROLYTE IMBALANCE IS<< MAN>>IFESTED, MOTOFEN ® SHOULD

card.plain: It fires on the first word or word start in shouted all-caps warning sentences.
